company.longBusinessSummary: NTT, Inc. operates as a telecommunications company in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Comprehensive ICT Business, Regional Communications Business, Global Solutions Business, and Others segments. Its Comprehensive ICT Business segment offers mobile phone and fiber-optic broadband services; financial, content, and lifestyle services; and corporate communication services and solutions.
